coverage: Bodo, Lofoten, Vesteralen, Tromso and Finnmark through North Cape and Kirkenes. Mainland Norway and coastal islands only; excludes Svalbard and Jan Mayen. Adjacent editions overlap by 0.5 degrees latitude (approximately 56 km).
label: Northern Norway

landValidationNotes.north-cape: The cliff-edge Explore coordinate is 3.5 m outside the pinned coastal polygon. Check the nearby plateau interior at all zooms; retain the Explore coordinate.
